segments.title: Chương 275: 0277【Cả ôm cả ấp】
segments.content:
The autumn morning sun of the capital, piercing through curtains that weren't fully drawn, had already quietly spread across the hotel room with the dawn's light.

A patch of light danced at the base of the room's wall, swaying gently as the wind blew the curtains, like a strip of silky, flowing red ribbon…

Alright, let's cut the crap.

Chen Guiliang was woken up by the need to pee. After relieving himself and coming back to check the time, he found it was only just past six in the morning.

Bian Guanyue and Tao Xue were sound asleep.

The former's sleeping posture was quite demure and elegant.

The latter was splayed out like a starfish.

Chen Guiliang rubbed his forehead, vaguely recalling how they got here last night. Zhang Guoli had been plastered too. It was a tipsy Deng Jie who had called an assistant to come act as a driver.

The couple's Grand Cherokee only had five seats.

At the time, Zhang Guoli was in the front passenger seat, and Deng Jie was at the far end of the back row. Three people were left, but there were only two seats.

Tao Xue had dazedly climbed onto Chen Guiliang's lap, but Bian Guanyue pulled at her a few times, saying they could squeeze four people in the back.

Tao Xue kept yelling, "But I don't want to," while Bian Guanyue said, "Get down."

Then Tao Xue was really pulled off, and she took the chance to fall asleep in Bian Guanyue's arms.

Deng Jie was also in a half-drunk, half-sober state, sitting beside them and watching the spectacle with a grin.

What a mess.

Damn, those guys were really good at pressuring people to drink.

Especially Feng Kuzi and Guo Degang. They didn't know each other well at first, but after a few drinks, they became the best of buddies.

Yu Qian'er began his performance in the latter half of the night, swaying as he grabbed Feng Kuzi and said, "I know you, but you don't know me. I've worked with Wang Shuo and Ye Jing, and I've even seen you on set. You've definitely forgotten me, haven't you?"

"I wouldn't dare forget, wouldn't… dare. You're Teacher Yu. Come, let's have a drink, you and I!" Feng Kuzi said.

"Bottoms up! Whoever doesn't is a son of a bitch!"

"Cheers!"

The moment Feng Kuzi finished, Zhang Guoli was there to pour him another drink, not letting his glass stay empty for more than three seconds.

Feng Kuzi then came over to Chen Guiliang with his glass. "Boss Chen, I, Feng Kuzi, am a crude man. The people I admire most in this life are you cultural folks. Whether it's art, or writing… you are all… this!"

The guy could barely stand, holding his glass in one hand and the table in the other. Then he let go of the table, freeing his hand to give a thumbs-up, shaking his head and reciting poetry right there.

Chen Guiliang was pestered into a corner and had no choice but to drink another glass.

When Feng Kuzi got drunk, he started complaining, saying that filming *The Banquet* was a case of being forced into something he was unprepared for, and that he had zero interest in Hamlet.

Zhang Guoli asked, "Then what do you want to film?"

After downing his glass, Feng Kuzi nearly fell, clinging to Zhang Guoli, who was pouring him yet another drink. "I just want to film *Back to 1942*. I've been thinking about it for over ten years. Liu Zhenyun won't give me the script, says I'm not good enough yet. That son of a bitch is so malicious, just holding onto it and not letting me shoot… If I filmed *1942*, I would definitely win an award. Not just in China, I'd go to Berlin, to Cannes, to the Oscars and win!"

"If you film *1942*, I'll be your leading man!" Zhang Guoli said, thumping his chest.

"Good brother!"

Feng Kuzi was deeply moved, then immediately complained again, "Sigh, no one is willing to invest. I'm frantically making commercial films now just to earn more money, to build up my reputation, so that Huayi will invest in an art film for me in the future! Am I fated to only make commercial films and get cursed at? I want to be the grandmaster who makes art films, not the grandson who makes commercial films!"

Guo Degang gave a thumbs-up. "Every grandmaster started out as a grandson. Sooner or later, you'll be the grandmaster!"

Feng Kuzi then went to embrace Guo Degang, and the two grandsons who had yet to become grandmasters downed two more glasses together.

By the end, Feng Kuzi was even holding onto Chen Guiliang, saying he was a multi-millionaire and asking if he was willing to invest in *1942*.

Even in his drunken stupor, Chen Guiliang still knew how to be evasive. It seemed like he agreed, but also like he didn't.

That film was a guaranteed money-loser.

But Feng Kuzi knew it would lose money and still wanted to shoot it. If he didn't, it would always be on his mind.

Chen Guiliang studied the two peacefully sleeping girls.

After a careful look, Bian Guanyue was still prettier.

But Tao Xue was definitely a beauty as well, and her lively and cute personality added a few more points.

Sigh, what a headache.

I'd love to be a scumbag, but I was born a straight-laced guy. How am I supposed to pull this off?

Having a girl in each arm only exists in dreams, but the problem is, I'm awake now.

Well then, I'll just lie back down and continue daydreaming.

Pretend I never woke up.

The two girls were still sound asleep.

Chen Guiliang climbed back into bed, lying between the two girls. He tried to feign sleep but couldn't, so he just looked to his left for a while, then to his right.

After admiring them for a good while, Tao Xue suddenly rolled over.

Chen Guiliang thought she was waking up and quickly closed his eyes.

Tao Xue rolled over and bumped into Chen Guiliang, mistaking him for a stuffed toy. In her drowsy state, she tugged on his arm.

Naturally, she couldn't move it, so Tao Xue shifted over herself, hugging Chen Guiliang and throwing a leg over his stomach.

This position was very dangerous.

What would Bian Guanyue think if she woke up and saw this?

An idea struck Chen Guiliang. He slipped his other arm under Bian Guanyue's neck.

With a slight lift of his arm, Bian Guanyue subconsciously scooted over, sleeping nestled in his arms just as she usually did.

Chen Guiliang felt pleased with himself: I really am a clever little devil.

He continued to feign sleep.

At first, he was quite excited, since this technically counted as having a girl in each arm.

As the excitement gradually faded, his feigned sleep turned into real sleep.

He didn't know how much time had passed, but Bian Guanyue began to stir.

She felt herself sleeping in Chen Guiliang's arms, so she snuggled contentedly and started tracing patterns on his chest with her hand. Suddenly, she touched another hand, and so she intertwined her fingers with it.

Huh, why is this hand so soft and small?

Bian Guanyue, still half-asleep, froze for a moment, then opened her eyes.

Less than a foot away was another girl's face.

"Ah!"

Bian Guanyue was instantly wide awake, all traces of sleepiness gone, and let out a bloodcurdling scream as if she had seen a ghost.

Chen Guiliang was also startled awake.

"What's going on?" Tao Xue said, rubbing her eyes, not yet understanding what had happened.

Then, she became a little embarrassed and quickly let go of Chen Guiliang, moving her leg off his stomach as well.

Tao Xue sat up in bed, noticed she was still dressed, and scratched her head. "How did I end up sleeping here? Where is this?"

Bian Guanyue was also trying to remember. She recalled them getting into the car together last night, checking in at the hotel front desk together, and then helping each other up the elevator.

But how did they end up sleeping together?

Thankfully, nothing strange had happened.

Chen Guiliang, feigning nonchalance, took out his phone to check the time. "The hotel breakfast probably hasn't been cleared away yet. Let's go downstairs and eat first."

Bian Guanyue sniffed herself. "I still smell like alcohol. I'm going to take a shower first."

She was more experienced. Every time she came here to hang out, she would pack a change of clothes in her bag.

Bian Guanyue went into the bathroom.

Tao Xue stuck her tongue out at Chen Guiliang, feeling a bit guilty. She knew it was wrong to be the third party, but she just couldn't forget him, like a moth drawn to a flame.

Besides, I'm clearly the one who met senior first!

Tao Xue followed her, washing her face and brushing her teeth in the washroom.

Listening to the whooshing sound of the shower, Tao Xue thought: She's definitely slept with senior. She even brought a change of clothes. Sigh, maybe I should just give up. I'm turning into the evil woman from a TV drama.

After washing up, Tao Xue returned to the room.

She wanted to say something but couldn't bring herself to, her heart still unwilling to let go.

Chen Guiliang, however, started chatting about something else. "I got too drunk last night, otherwise I definitely would have gone to see Ji Xiaolan's study."

Tao Xue said, "I asked Auntie Deng Jie about it during dinner last night. The so-called Ji Xiaolan's study there has nothing authentic. The ink, brushes, paper, and inkstones are all modern replicas."

"Is that so?" Chen Guiliang chuckled in surprise.

Tao Xue still remembered their conversation from before she got drunk. "It used to be a state-run restaurant, mainly for foreign guests, overseas Chinese, and cultural celebrities. Later it was criticized and turned into a canteen for workers, peasants, and soldiers, and many of the steles and plaques were destroyed. After the reform and opening-up, it became what it is now. It even hosted Kissinger and others."

It has been under protection in recent years, so the backyard is inaccessible. That's where Ji Xiaolan lived and studied.

It was precisely because of the popularity of *The Eloquent Ji Xiaolan* that many viewers saw him as a major figure and wrote letters calling for the protection of his former residence. Only then did it get official attention.

Actually, there are many places like this in the capital.

Tao Xue began to talk about *Notes of the Thatched Abode of Close Scrutiny*, saying she had read the book carefully. It even classified zombies into different levels: black zombies, white zombies, and roaming corpses.

"White zombies are formed from the recently deceased. Their faces are bluish-white, and they're afraid of rooster crows and the sound of metal," Tao Xue explained eloquently. "Black zombies are older zombies, covered in black hair. They suck life essence and are afraid of fire and sunlight. Roaming corpses are especially powerful. They usually lie in hundred-year-old coffins and can only be suppressed by a Daoist priest's talismans."

Chen Guiliang didn't know whether to laugh or cry. "What kind of books do you read all day?"

Tao Xue said, "I only got into these things after reading *Ghost Blows Out the Light*. Besides ancient books, I also watch ghost movies and zombie movies. If Ji Xiaolan lived in modern times, he would definitely be a bestselling author, specializing in ghosts and supernatural stories."

"Besides *Ghost Blows Out the Light*, what else do you read on Qidian?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Tao Xue thought to herself: I don't read on Qidian, it's full of harem novels. One male protagonist has tons of women, and they're often R-rated. Senior is a lot like a male protagonist from a novel. He's handsome and capable. Will he have a lot of women in the future?

Tao Xue was quite conflicted. She sort of hoped Chen Guiliang was a bit of a scumbag, otherwise she wouldn't have a chance. But she also hoped he was faithful, but only faithful to her. Hmph, at most, she could include Bian Guanyue!

Tao Xue thought for a moment. "There's a book called *The Grave Robbers' Chronicles* being serialized recently. It's written pretty well."

Chen Guiliang said, "*The Grave Robbers' Chronicles*? Then I'll have to go buy the adaptation rights."

Just then, Bian Guanyue finished her shower, brushed her teeth, and came out. "Let's go eat."
